name: Artoghrul Rashid
tagline: Building at Megasec, freelancing on CRMs and Shopify apps, studying CS at ADA. Ex-robotics mentor, occasional bassist. Baku.
intro: Full-stack web developer in Baku. I build internal systems and landing pages at Megasec, freelance on CRMs and Shopify apps, and study Computer Science at ADA. Before the web, I spent two years teaching kids robotics and electronics – there's still an ESP32 and a soldering iron somewhere on the desk.

experience.description: Building internal management systems and backend services in Laravel/PHP – workflow automation and database-driven features – plus responsive landing pages in Next.js, with a focus on performance and UX.
Web apps, CRM systems, and automation platforms in Node.js, Laravel, and Google Apps Script. Shopify integrations and frontends in Next.js, React, and Astro.

Taught kids aged 3–16 through project-based learning with VEX, LEGO SPIKE Prime, Arduino, and ESP32. Coached robotics competition teams, prepared students for international competitions, and trained staff.
